title.en: New Winter Veil Neighborhood Activities Updates in Patch 12.1.7
title.es: Nuevas actualizaciones de las actividades del vecindario de Winter Veil en el parche 12.1.7

summary.en: New Winter Veil Neighborhood Activities Updates in Patch 12.1.7...
summary.es: Nuevas actualizaciones de actividades del vecindario de Winter Veil en el parche 12.1.7...

contentHtml:
New achievements indicate that Housing Neighborhoods are getting updates for Winter Veil in Patch 12.1.7, which includes a new Tree Defense activity.

Hallow's End has some neighborhood activity updates, with daily quests and three neighborhood themes. It looks like Winter Veil might be the same, as in the latest Patch 12.1.7 PTR build, we've datamined new achievements that reference a "Tree Defense" activity in the neighborhood.

The Tree Defense appears to have power-ups, something called a Rotten Pummeler, the ability to punt tree attackers, and tasks players with returning presents. There also might be new daily quests that include carolers and delivering Candy Cane gifts to players.
  • NEW  Bells Will Be Ringing  Join in with the neighborhood carolers by successfully ringing your bells.
  • NEW  Candy Cane Brigade  Deliver 12 Candy Cane gifts within the housing neighborhoods.
  • Master of Merry Mayhem  Use a power-up 3 times in the tree defense activity.
    NEW Account Wide
  • NEW  Season's Beatings  Get pummeled 10 times by a Rotten Pummeler during the neighborhood tree defense activity.
  • NEW  Sockin' Around the Winter Veil Tree  Punt 100 tree attackers duing the neighborhood tree defense activity.
  • NEW  That's Not For You  Return Stolen Festive Presents to the neighborhood tree during the tree defense activitiy.
  • NEW  Tree-fense  Complete the neighborhood tree defense activity.
This looks like an exciting update to the neighborhood to help celebrate the Holiday season. We have datamined many new Winter Veil rewards that will probably be available as well!

title.es: Nuevas pociones de experiencia de bonificación del 30% con base de datos en el parche 12.1.7 PTR

summary.es: Nuevas pociones de experiencia de bonificación del 30% con base de datos en el parche 12.1.7 PTR...

contentHtml:
We've datamined four new potions on the Patch 12.1.7 PTR that grant a 30% bonus to experience.

In the latest Patch 12.1.7 PTR build, we've datamined four new potions. These potions are Bind to Warband, and all do the same thing: increase experience gains from quests and kills by 30% for 2 hours.

Bottle of Darkhaven Wisdom
Item Level 1
Binds to Warband
Use: Experience gained from killing monsters and completing quests is increased by 30% for 2 hrs.
Max Stack: 99
Bottle of Greenthistle Wisdom
Item Level 1
Binds to Warband
Use: Experience gained from killing monsters and completing quests is increased by 30% for 2 hrs.
Max Stack: 99
Bottle of Greywake's Wisdom
Item Level 1
Binds to Warband
Use: Experience gained from killing monsters and completing quests is increased by 30% for 2 hrs.
Max Stack: 99
Bottle of Court of Night Wisdom
Item Level 1
Binds to Warband
Use: Experience gained from killing monsters and completing quests is increased by 30% for 2 hrs.
Max Stack: 99


It's unclear exactly where these are from. While these could be part of the roguelite nature of the Talebound game mode, it's unlikely, as there probably wouldn't be a Bind to Warband flag on it. All four of these potions are named after the four stories of Talebound:
Blizzard
View Original
  • Darkhaven: Home to Konrad von Sonnesheim, The Lord Marshal, and Alexandre Dozsenc, The Blood Bishop.
  • Greenthistle Wood: Houses Granny Greenthumb, Witch of the Woods, Ylska Vilefang, Witch of the Wilds, and Mobog, The Giant of Greenthistle.
  • Greywake's Expedition: The tale of the many who have fallen to Zzyg'th, The Hadal Tyrant, and Chathoa, The Herald from Beyond.
  • Grove of the Night Court: A frightening chronicle of Tilywth, The Fairy Queen, and Maernok, The Nightmare King
As the names match up, these experience potions may be rewards from completing these stories in Talebound. We've datamined some quests that ask you to complete a story, so these quests could reward them. Alternatively, these could be general Talebound rewards. 30% bonus experience is a sizeable increase for those who want to level up more characters!

title.en: Catch Up on Renown Quickly with Aqir Invasions
title.es: Ponte al día con el renombre rápidamente con las invasiones de Aqir

summary.en: Catch Up on Renown Quickly with Aqir Invasions...
summary.es: Ponte al día con el renombre rápidamente con las invasiones de Aqir...

contentHtml:
If you're looking to quickly level your Midnight Faction renown, complete Aqir Invasions weekly for exchange tokens.

Aqir Invasions


Aqir Invasions are one of the new activities in Patch 12.1.5. The event takes place every hour, on the hour, and begins with Stage 1, which lasts for 10 minutes. During this time, players will fly around the zone and complete objectives in the marked location. After 10 minutes, an Aqir Monstrosity will spawn, and players have a limited amount of time to take it down.

The first two times you defeat the Aqir Monstrosity each week, you will get a Aqir Research Token. This can be turned in at the Aqir Vendors, located in Silvermoon City at /way #2393 39.4 80.4. Talk to Matildeux Osril, where you can choose which reputation you want to gain:
  • 2,500 reputation with Silvermoon Court
  • 2,500 reputation with Amani Tribe
  • 2,500 reputation with Hara'ti
  • 2,500 reputation with Singularity
  • 1,250 reputation with Zul'jarra's Forces
 


If you're looking to catch up on any of the Midnight faction reputations, this is a lot of reputation for very little work.

summary.es: Correcciones de errores de Den of Nalorakk y Murder Row - Parche 12.1.5 Correcciones en Vivo (Hotfixes)...

contentHtml:
Blizzard has posted hotfixes for today, which includes fixes for two high-profile Mythic+ bugs.

For Mythic+
  • The bug that caused Nalorakk's Echoing Roar to appear in the wrong location has been fixed.
  • The bug that caused Nibbles' Fel Spray to hit the wrong direction has been fixe.
  • The high-profile bug of Warlocks ninja pulling when a rogue is in a group has been fixed
For Everyday Players
  • Ascendant Venomstone item level has been fixed.
  • Another Labyrinth bug has been fixed.
Blizzard
View Original
October 23, 2026

Classes
  • Shaman
    • Enhancement
      • Resolved an issue causing Surging Elements to not appear on the Cooldown Manager.
  • Warlock
    • Fixed issues that caused some warlock summons and Diabolic Occuli to sometimes incorrectly target enemies outside of combat. This corrects summons from Affliction’s Shadows of Nath’reza, Demonology’s Dominion of Argus, as well as Diabolist summons.
Dungeons
  • Den of Nalorakk
    • Addressed an issue where Nalorakk’s Echoing Maul can sometimes happen in the wrong location.
  • Murder Row
    • Addressed an issue where Nibbles’ Fel Spray can hit targets outside of the intended area.
Hallow’s End
  • Neighborhoods
    • Players can now exit combat with the Shade of Seabreaker Skoloth.
Items
  • Fixed an issue that caused items upgraded with Ascendant Venomstones to have incorrect item levels.
Labyrinth
  • Shorter character models will no longer fall through floor when respawning in Jan’alai’s Refuge.

title.en: Subtlety Rogue Nerfs and Feral Druid Buffs - Class Tuning Incoming with Weekly Reset
title.es: Nerfs pícaros sutiles y aficionados a los Druidaas salvajes: afinación de clase entrante con reinicio semanal

summary.en: Subtlety Rogue Nerfs and Feral Druid Buffs - Class Tuning Incoming with Weekly Reset...
summary.es: Nerfs pícaros sutiles y aficionados a los Druidaas salvajes: afinación de clase entrante con restablecimiento semanal...

contentHtml:
Blizzard has announced upcoming class tuning which includes Feral Druid buffs and Subtlety Rogue nerfs.
Blizzard
View Original
The following class adjustments will arrive with scheduled weekly maintenance (October 27 in this region).

CLASS CHANGES

  • DRUID

    • Feral
      • All damage done increased by 5%. Does not affect PvP combat.
    • Restoration
      • Developer’s note: These changes are intended to help Restoration Druid deal with burst damage in dungeons, as they are behind other healers. They are performing well in raid settings, so we are targeting talents and abilities that are favored when healing a 5-person group.
      • Verdancy healing increased by 60%. Does not affect PvP combat.
      • Regrowth healing increased by 10%. Does not affect PvP combat.
      • Improved Swiftmend increases Swiftmend healing by 40% (was 30%). Does not affect PvP combat.

  • HUNTER

    • Marksmanship
      • Developers’ notes: These changes are intended to boost the area damage effectiveness of Marksmanship Hunters.
      • Trick Shots now increases the ricochet damage of Aimed Shot and Rapid Fire by 85% (was 75%).
      • Explosive Shot damage increased by 10%.
      • Volley damage increased by 10%.

  • MAGE

    • Fire
      • All damage done increased by 5%. Does not affect PvP combat.

  • ROGUE

    • Subtlety
      • Developers’ notes: The buff Subtlety received as compensation alongside changes in the 12.1.5 patch overshot expectations, so we’re rolling back a significant portion of that buff. In addition, the patch changes benefitted Trickster more than Deathstalker, so Trickster is receiving an additional smaller nerf.
      • All ability damage reduced by 8%.
      • Trickster: Fazed now increases damage by 5% (was 7%).

  • WARLOCK

    • Affliction
      • Unstable Affliction damage increased by 20%. Does not affect PvP combat.
    • Destruction
      • Rain of Fire damage increased by 20%.

PLAYER VERSUS PLAYER

  • DEATH KNIGHT

    • Unholy
      • Developers’ notes: The last adjustments to San’layn did increase its viability, but the impact of Vampiric Strike has been higher than we would like.
      • San’layn: Vampiric Strike damage reduced by 20% in PvP combat.

  • DEMON HUNTER

    • Devourer
      • Collapsing Star damage increased by 20% in PvP combat.

  • EVOKER

    • Preservation
      • Chronowarden: Chronal Dynamo increases the healing and damage of Living Flame by 80% when not an instant cast in PvP combat (was 50%).
      • Chronowarden: Reverberations now causes Verdant Embrace to heal for an additional 80% over 8 seconds in PvP combat (was 40%).

  • HUNTER

    • Marksmanship
      • Kill Shot damage increased by 40% in PvP combat.
      • Deathblow’s chance to be activated by Aimed Shot increased to 25% in PvP combat.
      • Dark Ranger: Black Arrow damage increased by 40% in PvP combat.

  • MAGE

    • Fire
      • Developers’ notes: Fire Mage has continued to overperform, so we’re decreasing its overall damage to bring it in line with expectations.
      • All damage reduced by 5% in PvP combat.
    • Frost
      • Developers’ notes: Frostfire has not been a competitive option for Frost Mages this season, so we’re increasing a few of its burst damage aspects to differentiate its damage profile from Spellslinger.
      • Frostfire: Isothermic Core’s Meteor damage increased by 20% in PvP combat.
      • Frostfire: Duality’s Pyroblast damage increased by 20% in PvP combat.

  • MONK

    • Mistweaver
      • Developers’ notes: Conduit of the Celestials has not been a competitive option for Mistweavers this season, so we’re increasing its consistent and burst healing.
      • Conduit of the Celestials: Celestial Conduit healing increased by 35% in PvP combat.
      • Conduit of the Celestials: Strength of the Black Ox absorb increased by 25% in PvP combat.

  • PALADIN

    • Holy
      • Developers’ notes: Holy Paladin’s throughput has been underperforming and we’re decreasing the mana cost of Holy Light to promote casted healing.
      • All healing increased by 5% in PvP combat.
      • Divine Favor now reduces the mana cost of Holy Light by 50% in PvP combat (was 30%).

  • PRIEST

    • Holy
      • Developers’ notes: These changes are aimed at further improving Archon’s viability in PvP with targeted increases to Prayer of Healing’s group healing and the power of proc effects from the tree.
      • Prayerful Litany now causes the primary target of Prayer of Healing to be healed for 75% more in PvP combat (was 125%).
      • Prayer of Healing healing increased by 30% in PvP combat.
      • Archon: Resonant Energy now increases healing done by 4% per stack in PvP combat (was 2%).
      • Archon: Empowered Surges now increases the healing of spells affected by Surge of Light by 10% in PvP combat (was 5%).
      • Archon: Realized Potential now increases Flash Heal healing by 25% in PvP combat (was 20%).

  • ROGUE

    • Assassination
      • Deathstalker: Deathstalker’s Mark damage increased by 20% in PvP combat.
      • Deathstalker: Hunt Them Down damage increased by 20% in PvP combat.
      • Deathstalker: Darkest Night now increases the damage of the next Eviscerate by 15% in PvP combat (was 8%).

  • SHAMAN

    • Restoration
      • Healing Stream Totem and Stormstream Totem healing increased by 20% in PvP combat.

title.en: World Bosses, Legendaries, and a Scourge Invasion - The WoW: Forever Beta is Over
title.es: World Bosses, Legendaries, and a Scourge Invasion - La beta de WoW: Forever ha terminado

summary.en: World Bosses, Legendaries, and a Scourge Invasion - The WoW: Forever Beta is Over...
summary.es: World Bosses, Legendaries, and a Scourge Invasion - La beta de WoW: Forever ha terminado...

contentHtml:
In the final hours of the WoW: Forever Beta, Blizzard decided to go out with a bang, giving players fun and chaotic events throughout the world.

Tweet #2113297144165896222


Players would first find a new NPC in front of capital cities, offering unique consumables such as fireworks, a scroll that increases your and others' speed around you, and a potion that increases experience gained by 200%.

 


Players would also find world bosses in starting zones, ranging from Azuregos, "Super" Hogger, Voracious, Thunderaan, and Lord Kazzak!


Voracious

Super Hogger

Thunderaan

Azuregos


Defeating these world bosses gave players some familiar and powerful legendaries, including Sulfuras, Hand of Ragnaros, and Thunderfury, Blessed Blade of the Windseeker!

Tweet #2113348047342326176


Along with getting these legendaries, players could also farm full Classic Tier 1 set bonuses and Molten Core weapons from mobs in every starter zone.



But it appears all of that wasn't enough, as Blizzard decided to re-release the contaminated boxes from the Wrath of the Lich King Scourge Event back in 2008, spreading the Scourge plague across Azeroth!



The WoW: Forever beta was a massive success, and players can't wait to jump back into Azeroth on November 4th. We'll see what other surprises are in store for us at launch!
